description: This file defines a Flutter StatefulWidget screen called KycScreen for verifying user identity. It includes form fields for personal information, handles form submission, communicates with providers for KYC data saving and authentication, and navigates upon successful completion.

classes.name: KycScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget representing the KYC verification screen.
